input_semantics.consequence: A difference against an OGB leaderboard number cannot be attributed to the split; it can be attributed to (a) the input featurisation and (b) the model family. This round reports it that way instead of claiming an exact-match win.
input_semantics.lcrc_input: Graphs rebuilt from the official SMILES with the frozen lipo_v1 adapter: atom_class (element x aromatic, 15 classes), formal-charge bucket, total-H bucket, directed bond class/stereo, plus the frozen lipo_v1 per-atom scalars and global descriptors that the FeatureSpec derives from the RDKit molecule.
input_semantics.not_used: ogbg-molhiv node-feat.csv.gz / edge-feat.csv.gz / num-*-list.csv.gz are NOT read as model input, and the 324 MB PyG processed artifact is not used at all; using them would change the method definition (the model would consume OGB's feature engineering instead of the frozen LCRC structural encoding).
input_semantics.ogb_reference_input: PyG graphs with 9-dimensional node features (atomic number, chirality, degree, formal charge, num H, radical electrons, hybridisation, aromaticity, ring membership) and 3-dimensional edge features (bond type, stereo, conjugation), plus pre-computed num-node/num-edge lists; the official examples feed these tensors straight into a GNN.
